title: Regional Climate Parity
scenario: Identify regions where the standard deviation of humidity across all sensors is lower than the previous month.
tableSchema: weather_data (sensor_id INT, reading_date DATE, humidity NUMERIC)
correctQuery: WITH monthly_stats AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', reading_date) as mon, STDDEV(humidity) as sd FROM weather_data GROUP BY mon) SELECT mon FROM (SELECT mon, sd, LAG(sd) OVER(ORDER BY mon) as prev_sd FROM monthly_stats) t WHERE sd < prev_sd;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (sensor_id INT, reading_date DATE, humidity NUMERIC);
